title: Step-back prompting: stepping back to generalise before answering

videos.script: It is a Wednesday, and a public holiday. A customer asks the café for a hot toastie at a quarter to twelve. {{question}} Asked directly, a model can latch on to the word Wednesday and answer from the weekday hours. Yes, the kitchen is open until half past five. {{direct}} The rule that decides it is somewhere else. On a holiday the café keeps Sunday hours, and on Sunday it closes at noon. {{rule}} Step-back prompting asks the general question first. What rules decide the last hot food order on any day? {{step}} The model writes the rules down. Then the original question goes in beside them, and the answer has the principle in front of it. {{second}} In this lesson you build those two prompts, see when the extra call is worth it, and count what it costs. {{cost}}
